body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its 3G Quad Band smartphone 'U1' at the CES 2009, which features a 2.9-inch LCD VGA touchscreen and Windows Mobile 6.1 Professional.
